194:t_1:172.en:
$n
「Sorry... Once I use 《$$ブーストアップ$$》, I can't summon $$ジェニオン$$ for an hour.」

194:t_1:173.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Why would you use something that important...!?」

194:t_1:174.en:
$$ノノ$$
「To save Big Sis, of course! Isn't that obvious!」

194:t_1:176.en:
$$ノノ$$
「We can't let $n's effort and guts go to waste!」

194:t_1:178.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! I'll go with you, Big Sis!」

194:t_1:180.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ギルター$$! We'll be your opponents!」

194:t_1:181.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Mind you, most of your soldiers have gone to the live show, so security is probably thin!」

194:t_1:182.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh... heh heh... That short-sightedness of yours has shortened your lives.」

194:t_1:185.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I don't need to rely on a rabble of ordinary soldiers. I have $$バイオロイド$$s and $$インセクト$$s under my command.」

194:t_1:186.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Now, my loyal soldiers! Trample those ants that have crept into the base I manage to your hearts' content...」

194:t_1:189.en:
$$宗介$$
「Did you think we were waiting for the order to start the battle, you third-rate hack...!」

194:t_1:190.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$バイオロイド$$ units, to the front! Kill them!」

194:t_1:192.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Impossible! $$バイオロイド$$s, to a handgun...!」

194:t_1:194.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn it! All forces, charge! Don't let them escape!」

194:t_1:195.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I wonder who the short-sighted one was, $$ギルター$$!」

194:t_1:196.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「All hands, all-out attack! If it's come to this, let's raise some hell!」

194:t_1:203.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「Ha ha ha ha ha! It's a blast not having to hold back!」

194:t_1:204.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「Considering who we're up against! Go all out, $$ハレルヤ$$!」

194:t_1:205.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「You don't have to tell me!」

194:t_1:206.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Yeah! If the enemy's machines, I can put my digging power to use too!」

194:t_1:208.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Fu, fu, fu... fu, fu, fu...」

194:t_1:209.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$甲児$$! Today you and I are settling this together!」

194:t_1:210.en:
$$甲児$$
「Got it, $$竜馬$$! Let's go out dynamic!」

194:t_1:215.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-what is this!? A dream... a nightmare, at that!」

194:t_1:216.en:
$n
「Keep talking like that and you'll never wake up again, $$ギルター$$!」

194:t_1:217.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Keep charging! We're liberating the detention facility!」

194:t_1:219.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-wait! Not one step further...!」

194:t_1:220.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't think there's any further for you.」

194:t_1:221.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's enjoy the present to the fullest, $$ギルター$$!」

194:t_1:222.en:
$$ギルター$$
「N-no way... I don't wanna...」

194:t_1:226.en: ～ $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$ Live Venue ～

194:t_1:227.en:
$$クラン$$
(They're just not getting into it...)

194:t_1:228.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
(We were only a knock-off $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ to begin with, so I figured there'd be a limit, but it looks like we'll hit it sooner than expected.)

194:t_1:229.en:
$$カナリア$$
(It seems word that the infiltration unit was discovered has reached the soldiers too.)

194:t_1:230.en:
$$ミシェル$$
(Not good... The troops here might get deployment orders too.)

194:t_1:231.en:
$$アルト$$
(These guys' morale isn't high. If we get them more fired up about the live show, we should be able to stall them a bit longer even if orders come...!)

194:t_1:232.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Hey... Is this all there is to the famous $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$?」

194:t_1:233.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「That's strange... When I heard them sing on the Western Oceania front, it hit me a lot harder, right in the heart...」

194:t_1:234.en:
$$ミシェル$$
(The audience is getting noisier. Maybe we're at our limit...)

194:t_1:235.en:
$$カナリア$$
(Tell $$ルカ$$. We'll withdraw when the time is right.)

194:t_1:236.en:
$$アルト$$
(Damn...! And we haven't even found $$シェリル$$ and the others yet...)

194:t_1:241.en:
$$カナリア$$
「$$ルカ$$...! Cut the sound source!」

194:t_1:242.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go!! Listen to my soooong!!」

194:t_1:244.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Th-that aura...! The one who came later must be the real one!」

194:t_1:245.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Then the ones who were on stage first were fakes!」

194:t_1:247.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Yeah! This beat running through my body, I can't get enough!」

194:t_1:250.en:
$$クラン$$
「The atmosphere changed in an instant...!」

194:t_1:251.en:
$$バサラ$$
「What a great crowd! Then I'll just keep them coming!」

194:t_1:252.en:
$$アルト$$
「All right...! We'll leave this to $$バサラ$$ and pull out.」

194:t_1:253.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Quit sneaking around, $$アルト$$! Let me hear your soul's shout!」

194:t_1:254.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Deliver your song to those two!!」

kept_omissions: 194:t_1:172: object/addressee of the apology and whose Boost Up is unspecified; kept 'I' as $n using it, addressee left implicit.
194:t_1:173: object of the verb omitted in the Japanese; rendered 'use something that important' (Boost Up, inferred from 172).
194:t_1:174/176: Nono says $n used Boost Up to save Lal'C; the beneficiary/effect of the Boost Up left as in Japanese.
194:t_1:222: Girtar's やだ has no object; kept as 'I don't wanna...' (trailing).
194:t_1:254: 'two' (Sheryl and Ranka) left as 'those two'; Alto's reply is in dlg_2028_03.
uncertain: 172/173/176: what Boost Up does (who benefits) is unclear from the slice; I render it as $n spending the ability to help Lal'C/Nono escape.
181: Cayenne's もっとも... read as aimed at Girtar ('your soldiers'); Girtar's reply (182) supports it.
182/195: 浅慮 rendered 'short-sightedness' to keep the 寿命を縮めた pun ('shortened your lives') and Ozma's echo.
199: 野郎共 = 'boys' (Mao to Sousuke/Kurz); 202 long 'rock and roll'.
206: 穴掘力 = 'digging power' (Andy W. Hole joke).
207: モローイ chant rendered 'Mallooy'; 208 Sazanka's 腐 laugh rendered plain 'Fu, fu, fu' (loses the 'rot/fujoshi' pun).
217: 収容施設を解放 = 'liberating the detention facility' (caption in 2028_00 calls it Detention Facility).
226: caption 'Live Venue' kept on the Japanese layout (6 fullwidth spaces); Neo Alcatraz token as in 2028_00.
228/232: 'Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ' uses the keyword token (no 《》 links here); なんちゃって = 'knock-off'. ミーナ = pt251 (Quarter operator, Mina).
243: '$$熱気バサラ$$s' plural after full-name token; 248 '$$バサラ$$aaaaaa' stretched suffix after token (check the builder accepts it).
236: 発見されてない read as 'we haven't found Sheryl and the others yet' (could be 'they haven't been found by the enemy').
